trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the service is healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

I chose v2.3.0 because it is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are both marked unhealthy. Because v2.3.0 has run in production before, no change-manager approval was needed.

I opened SEV2 incident INC-0002 describing the failure, the rollback, and the post-rollback status. It paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt to create the incident timed out and did not create anything, so I retried once. The incident list confirms only one incident was opened.

Follow-up items in the incident:
- Investigate the v2.3.1 regression.
- Keep v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc from being redeployed until the root cause is found.
- Confirm checkout traffic and error rates have fully recovered.
